page.overview:
Who is Allan?

On his way to the Spirit's Grave, Link overhears a group of young boys speaking in fear of a ghost. Once the Power Bracelet is obtained in the dungeon nearby, Link can lift the rock blocking the entrance to the tomb and investigate for himself. Inside he discovers a Poe named Allan, who is harmless and simply wishes to have its headstone moved, as its actual self is trapped within the grave. Using the Power Bracelet, Link is able to accord it the favor, allowing Allan to move on to the afterlife. As thanks, it gives him its Poe Clock, which is the first item in the .

Allan's name is a play on the name of the famous writer, Edgar Allan Poe.
